purpose: Evidence gathered before deployment, for the deployment session to complete. It follows guide §7 as amended by contract §13 (docs/handoffs/pre-deployment-interface-contract-20260922.md), with the owner's approval at each ⚠ step, and writes the final receipt docs/qa/<name>-release-<date>.json at step 10. Nothing in this draft was deployed, broadcast or written to Vercel.

currentProduction.rollback: Vercel Instant Rollback to this deployment only; never rebuild or redeploy a pre-1.8.0 commit with production env (contract §13, emergency stops 4).

toComplete.vercelSecrets: names only (RANKED_VERIFIER_PRIVATE_KEY, RANKED_RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY, RANKED_SCORE_REGISTRY_ADDRESS, CRON_SECRET, rotated SESSION_SECRET); the legacy names absent (step 6)
toComplete.productionMigration: schemaVersion and counts printed by scripts/live-cron.mjs (step 8b)
toComplete.liveRuns: one Ranked run per game (step 9): entry tx, settle confirmed, getSession on chain, Neon row, leaderboard row, profile stats, achievements, share card unfurl
toComplete.publicHashes: sha256 of every public shell, stylesheet, dist chunk, atlas and manifest against the local build (as in docs/qa/master-list-release-20260917.json publicVerification)

stateAtDraft.readme: README.md 'How Ranked works now' describes the launch flow; the version, cache marker and production lines are unchanged until step 8.

rehearsal.what: The server end to end on an in-process Hardhat chain 4441 with PGlite: sign-in, seed ticket, paid entry, /api/settle replay and relayed publish, index, leaderboard, profile and achievements for all three games (in process and over local HTTP), the negative cases, and the phase-2 NFT rehearsal.

step7DryRun.what: The step-3 address module and the step-7 flag flip rehearsed in a throwaway worktree (removed afterwards): the files each step changes, the regenerated public copy, and the tests step 7 must update. Refreshed by the browser-e2e slice at its final commit.

liveFlagBrowserRun.what: The real browser Ranked flow with both flags on (a throwaway live-flag portal, the rehearsal's local stack, the fixture EIP-6963 wallet on a Hardhat account): sign-in with one signature, the 0.102 zkLTC entry, the entry sessionId32 equal to the settle request's, the results screen published with explorer links, the share row at /s/<shareId>, the share page and card, the signed-out and Ranked-title launch copy, and a clean console and network, once per game; with Chikun also the unlockables path (E6 unlock, E7 cosmetics PUT, the look in the Free and Ranked child).
liveFlagBrowserRun.walletConnect: not exercised: localhost is not a Reown-allowed host

results.result: PASS 8/8 flows on desktop and mobile with the harness's own server (apps/portal as the web root). Against python's http.server, pause-resume and mid-run-restart fail because it answers no HTTP Range request; ranked-preview passes there too.

previewSmokes.afterStep7: These smokes assert the preview. Against a portal that serves SETTLEMENT_LIVE = true, the Chikun preview smoke and the simulated-wallet smoke exit 2, stacked-playable runs its Free viewports and reports its Ranked preview passes as not run, and hmh-reboot-portal-e2e reports ranked-preview as not run.

measured.result: HMH_REBOOT_TEST_RETIREMENT_GATE PASS (npm run vercel:build, browser-e2e slice, 2026-09-23)
